$comment: The source of sf-language's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), in the 1.4 form (scripts/generate-component-files.mjs writes rule.js, aliases.json, studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json, probe.json and smart.manifest.json from it). A new component, made against standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 and vocabulary 1.1.5: the site's language picker of the owner decision of 2026-11-06 (Federation bus msg-3063edc9fe684dfe9909).

languages.summary: The languages, as BCP 47 codes separated by spaces or commas: «ru en de ar», «pt-BR». Each is named in itself and in English: the names of the 56 languages the component supports ship with it (data/names.json, CLDR), the browser (Intl.DisplayNames) names any other. items, when given, takes its place

items.summary: The languages as a list, each {code, label?, short?, href?, missing?}: label replaces the shipped or browser name («Deutsch» written otherwise), short the code the trigger and labels="code" show, href the address of the site in that language, missing true for a language this page has no translation of (as missing). A property, or the JSON island a server prints; when it holds a language it is the list, and languages is not read

href.summary: The address of the site in each language, as a pattern with {code}: «/{code}/» gives /ru/ and /en/. A language with its own href keeps it. A language with an href is followed, not applied in the page

missing.summary: The languages this page has no translation of, as codes («de fr»; owner decision C142 (6)). They stay in the list, each menu row with the line «нет перевода — откроется главная» under its name, and a choice goes to home in that language

home.summary: The address of the site's main page in each language, as a pattern with {code} («/{code}/»): where a language of missing goes. Not set, a missing language goes to its own href

mode.summary: The look. auto: two languages and more are a button with the current code («RU ▾») and a menu (menu), eight and more the menu with search (search), on a phone a sheet at the bottom -- one button for every count (owner decision C142). inline is the segmented switch, for a settings page where every language is in sight (the arrows move, Enter or Space chooses); field is a form field (sf-dropdown with its label above, C142 (8)); menu and search fix those looks. One language draws nothing in every mode

inline-max.summary: In auto mode, the most languages drawn as a segmented switch; 1, the default since 1.4.0 (owner decision C142), never: auto draws the button and menu from two languages. A settings page writes mode="inline" for the switch

search-from.summary: In auto mode, the number of languages from which the menu has a search field

labels.summary: What the switch's segments say: name, the language's name in itself (Русский · English); code, its code (RU · EN), each segment keeping the name as its accessible name. The menu and the trigger are not affected: the trigger shows the code. The former boolean compact is a dated alias of labels="code" (owner decision C134: compact means density only; noted in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01, journal attribute-language-compact-to-labels-code)

size.summary: The ladder rung: the trigger is a button of that size, the switch a segmented control of that size; the menu's rows are 32 px up to 1/2 and 40 px from 1. 1/2 fits the tools slot of sf-header-site

trigger.summary: The menu's trigger (looks menu and search): code, the default, the translate glyph, the current code and the arrow («文A RU ▾», C142 (1)); icon, the translate glyph alone (owner decision C369, the docs header), a square icon button of the size's step, ghost, named «Язык: Русский» and showing that name as the Framework's tooltip (C160). name, the glyph and the current language's own name («Русский», «Deutsch») in the link role (component link, owner decisions C381, C186: the navigation form, the ink and size of its place, no fill in any state, the line under the name on hover, press, keyboard focus and while open, the link's focus ring), as wide as the name, no tooltip (the name is shown), still named «Язык: Русский». The menu is the same. Core holds the trigger's box before the code arrives (--sf-language--trigger: the code's width, the icon's square, the name's line)

shrink.summary: How the code trigger gives way when the bar it stands in asks it to (group build 20, the docs header; as sf-button shrink, owner decision C370): code, the current code and the arrow without the translate glyph («RU ▾»), one text line narrower, keeping its name «Язык: Русский» and its tooltip; none, never. sf-header-site with collapse auto, or a collapse step with fit, asks first, before its nav gives way (C372), by the host state data-shrunk. The icon and name triggers and the inline and field looks do not shrink

apply.summary: What a choice of a language without an href does after its change event: page sets it for the page (SF.language.use(code), lang and dir on <html>); none only changes the value, for a settings form the server applies

remember.summary: A name to keep the choice under: the chosen code is a preference of the person (SF.Preferences key sf-language/<name>; in the browser localStorage sf-pref:sf-language/<name>, and a host that keeps preferences for its user gets it). Reading it back before the first paint is the site's (docs.md); the element shows the language of <html lang>

label.summary: The control's name: the switch's group and the menu are named by it, the trigger by it and the current language's name in itself, «Язык: Русский» (the code the trigger shows is not its name). «Язык» / «Language» in the page language when not set

name.summary: Native form field name: the element submits the chosen code with its form, a form reset restores the value it was written with, and a disabled element is left out

disabled.summary: Disables the trigger or the switch

value.summary: The chosen language's code. Not set, the element shows the language of <html lang> when it is one of the list (the same code, else the same primary language), else the first

look.summary: What the element draws now, by mode and the count of languages; also the host state data-look

href.summary: The language's address; empty when it has none.

reason.summary: A person's press, or select() from code.

change.summary: A language was chosen: the request, sent before anything changes. Cancelled, nothing changes (the switch goes back) -- a site that navigates itself (a router, a Docara page that keeps its path) cancels it and goes. Not cancelled, the value is the code, remember keeps it, and the element goes to href, or with apply page applies the language to the page. The name to bind

select.summary: Chooses a language by its code as a press would, sending change with reason api: refused {reason: unknown} for a code not in the list, {reason: unchanged} for the shown one, {reason: disabled}, {reason: prevented} when a page cancels change

relations.name: cl-button-icon
$comment: trigger icon (C369): the glyph alone is sf-button-icon, which shows its own name tooltip (C160 (1)).

relations.name: link
$comment: trigger name (C381): the trigger is a native button in the link role, drawn by the link sheet.

relations.name: tooltip
$comment: The trigger's name as the Framework's tooltip (C160 (1), TT-11): the controller and its sheet, fetched when a menu trigger draws.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: Menu (auto from two languages, C142): the trigger is sf-button's native button named «Язык: Русский» (label and the current language in itself; the visible code «RU» is not the name) with aria-haspopup menu and aria-expanded while open; the menu is sf-menu-context named by label, a menuitemradio per language with its own lang, the keys of sf-menu-context, Escape returns focus to the trigger. Inline (mode="inline"): sf-segmented's radio group named by label, a radio per language with its own lang, the arrows move and choose as in sf-segmented. Nothing is announced: the page's language is what changes.

x-summary: The site's language picker. From two languages a button with the translate glyph, the current code and expand_more («RU ▾», one width whatever is chosen) opens a menu at the C32 panel width, each row the name in itself and its name in the page's language beside it; eight and more the same menu with search, on a phone a sheet at the bottom. A settings page can write mode="inline" for a segmented switch (the arrows move, Enter chooses), a form mode="field" for a dropdown field with its label; an app menu takes SfLanguage.menuEntry() for its «Язык» row. A language without this page stays, marked «нет перевода — откроется главная». One language draws nothing. A choice is a cancellable change; then the element follows the language's href or applies the language to the page (SF.language.use, lang and dir on <html>).

x-source.brief: Owner decision 2026-11-06 relayed by the dispatcher (Federation bus msg-3063edc9fe684dfe9909): one Smart component sf-language that changes its look by the number of languages (1 nothing, 2-3 segmented, 4-7 menu, 8+ menu with search; thresholds overridable), Material Symbols translate, names from Intl.DisplayNames, SF.language.use with lang and dir on <html>, href per language and a cancellable change for URL-switching sites, optional remember, no flags, a form field by name; reference looks: ui-doc docs/menu-sets f1b9ea2d examples/smart-components/{segmented,context-menu,dropdown}/language

x-decisions: name: sf-language, a one-word family like sf-search (owner, 2026-11-06); the family language is the Framework's in contracts/registry/names.json. No sf-input-language: the element is itself a form field (name).

looks: by count, the owner's thresholds -- 1 none, 2-3 inline, 4-7 menu, 8+ search -- with inline-max (3) and search-from (8) to move them and mode inline|menu|search to fix one. The look is the value look and the host state data-look.

reuse: nothing is drawn by the element itself and it has no sheet. inline is sf-button-group appearance=segmented (a grouped control is the height of sf-button of the same size by the group's own rule); menu is sf-button-icon appearance=link scheme=on-surface with the Material Symbols translate glyph (not a globe; no flags) and sf-menu-context popup with radio rows; search is the menu's own local search. sf-button-group 1.2.0 gained an item's lang for this.

names (until 1.4.0): Intl.DisplayNames, no dictionary -- the name in itself (new Intl.DisplayNames([code]).of(code), with the language's own capital: «Русский», «Español»), in English for the menu's value column («Deutsch … German»), and in the page's language for the search only («нем» finds Deutsch on a Russian page). items[].label overrides the name; a code the browser cannot name shows as its code.

menu rows: the native name is the row's label, the English name its value at the row's end (left out when the two are the same, English), the radio mark on the chosen one. Each row carries lang; the English name sits inside that row, as in sf-menu-context's own language example.

search (until 1.4.0): sf-menu-context's local search over text, caption and keywords; the element puts the native name, the English name, the name in the page language and the code in keywords, so «нем», «German» and «de» all find Deutsch.

apply: change is the request, cancelable (vocabulary §5 change; the native name, the element being a form value control). Not cancelled: value is set, remember writes the code as a preference (SF.Preferences sf-language/<remember>: no Smart component touches localStorage itself, and a host that keeps preferences for its user gets it), then a language with an href is followed (location.assign) and one without is applied when apply=page: SF.language.use(code) -- which writes <html lang> -- and <html dir> from the language (Intl.Locale textInfo, else the right-to-left languages and scripts: ar, he, fa, ur, ps, sd, ug, yi, dv, ckb, syr …). Cancelled: nothing changes and the switch's plate goes back. Restoring a remembered language before the first paint is the site's (docs.md has the three lines).

value: an element written without value shows <html lang> when the list has it (the same code, else the same primary language), else the first language; after a choice the value is its own. select(value) is the action.

a11y: the trigger's accessible name and title are the word trigger, «Язык: Русский» / «Language: English» -- label and the current language in itself; every segment and row has lang; the keyboard is sf-button-group's (arrows, Home, End) and sf-menu-context's (arrows, letters, Enter, Escape back to the trigger; Down from the search field to the rows).

geometry: the parts are on the shared ladder; the element passes size through (1/3 .. 3). The menu has rungs 1/2 and 1: up to 1/2 its rows are 32 px, from 1 40 px. At 1/2 it fits sf-header-site's tools slot beside the theme switch (the same group height).
css-variables: none of its own -- it has no sheet; the parts' public variables (sf-button-group, sf-button-icon, sf-menu-context) reach it.

version 1.0.1 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (owner decisions D11b, D11c; one number above the unreleased 1.0.2 and 1.1.0 it joins): the inline switch is sf-segmented on its track (appearance track); its selected plate is the raised neutral one, the segmented control's new default, where it was the primary fill. The sf-button and sf-button-icon it draws are asked for their current names (appearance ghost for link, status danger for error; actions block, decisions C13 and C15), so the template uses no dated alias. Settings and events unchanged.

version 1.2.2: a patch, the first paint. Until data-look the element holds one control of its size step high, and in the menu and search modes as wide (the icon button it draws), from a rule in core.css (core.styles 1.7.1), since the element has no sheet and core.css is the one sheet a page links before any code; the box is the ladder's control height of the step (--sf-ui-<step>--control-height), so it follows the desktop and the mobile ladder. The switch holds its height only (its width is its labels'). Printed static markup (data-sf-static) is its own box, so nothing is reserved then. A page's own placeholder (Docara's 2.5rem box) becomes unnecessary. Settings, values, events and what it draws unchanged. Also: a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives the action's method its one object argument, select({value}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object); the element's code also takes the value alone, select(<string>), and the reference says so (x-registry.action-calls). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.3 (2026-11-10): a patch; nothing in the component changed. Its menu panel is sf-menu-context, which since 1.14.1 draws its frame without the late utility class flex (component.context-menu owns the layout), so the first-paint snapshots lose that class; the component takes a patch with them. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.
version 1.2.4 (2026-11-11): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element: the class button-group sheet changed (component.button-group 1.3.0, C47).

version 1.2.4, also (2026-11-11): the sf-button it draws writes sf-button--ghost beside the dated sf-button--link since sf-button 1.13.0 (CB-01), so the first-paint snapshots follow; the component takes a patch with them. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-13): a minor (owner decision C134, control/research/2026-11-13-navigation-density.md D5/Q1: the word compact means density only, data-sf-density). The setting labels (name | code, default name) says what the switch's segments show; the boolean compact, which showed the codes, leaves the settings and is a dated alias of labels="code", read in the element's code (a boolean's presence cannot be a value alias of the shim): it draws the same, and each page notes it once in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01 (journal attribute-language-compact-to-labels-code). labels written beside compact wins. The element's own uses (examples, probe, static snapshot) write labels="code".

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-14): a minor (research ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-language.md LG-5, LG-7, LG-8, LG-9; decision C32). Names: the names of the languages it supports ship with the component as data (data/names.json, CLDR 48 through ICU 78 -- each in itself, in English and in Russian) and come before the browser's Intl.DisplayNames, which names every other code and page language; headless Chromium named some only in English and sah only as a code. A name takes its capital in a list except in a script whose upper case is a display style, not the capital of running text. Search: the menu's search is remote (search.remote) and the element narrows the rows itself, by word starts -- each word of the query begins a word of the label, the native name, the English name, the name in the page language or the code, folded to lower case without accents -- so «ит» finds Italiano (итальянский) but not Lietuvių (литовский); keywords are no longer given. The search panel opens at decision C32's constant panel width (sf-menu-context width="panel": 20rem, 18rem compact) and keeps it while typing; it went with its longest row (288 to 257). Opening: the chosen language is scrolled into view in the menu's own list, kept there while the menu is placed (a placement measures the panel at its natural height and takes the list back to the top) until the person acts in the menu; in the menu look the chosen row takes the focus, so the arrows go on from it. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged. Also in 1.4.0 (owner decision C142 part 1, ui-control control/research/2026-11-14-language.md LG-1, LG-2; prototype prototypes/language-study.html #q-trigger and #q-few, variant B): the trigger is sf-button -- the Material Symbols translate glyph, the current language's code and expand_more («RU ▾»), ghost on-surface at the element's size -- where it was sf-button-icon with the glyph alone, so the language is in sight. Its label keeps one width whatever language is chosen: every code of the list stands in one grid cell and only the current one is visible, so the button is as wide as its widest code (no new value: the parts' own ladder). Its accessible name and title stay «Язык: Русский» (label in the page's language, the name in itself as shipped). auto draws this button and its menu from two languages (inline-max defaults to 1, was 3): three languages no longer jump from a 345 px track to a 40 px button when a fourth is added (LG-1). The segmented switch stays as mode="inline", for a settings page; a page that wrote inline-max keeps its switch. The relation cl-button-icon is cl-button. Values, events, keys and the menu unchanged. Also in 1.4.0 (owner decision C142 part 2, 2026-11-14, prototype #q-second..#q-region, all by recommendation): (3) a menu row's second name is the language's name in the page's language as it is written in running text («Deutsch немецкий» on a Russian page, W3C language navigation), none when it is the same word as the name; it was the English name. Every menu is decision C32's panel width (width="panel", 20rem, 18rem compact) so it is not cut. (4) In the switch (mode="inline") the arrows, Home and End move the focus and choose nothing; Enter or Space presses the focused segment, which chooses it (the element takes the keys in the capture phase before sf-segmented's own, which choose). (5) From search-from languages on a phone (below the md breakpoint, sf-menu-context's own test) the menu opens as sf-menu-context's sheet at the bottom of the screen (openFor width form: the sheet a form takes there, 20rem / 18rem elsewhere like the panel), its search on top, no field focused, the chosen row in view and focused; rows are the touch rows (44). Up to search-from the menu stays a popover by the trigger. Checked in a headed Chrome at 390 and 360 with touch emulation; a real phone is still owed. (6) A language this page has no translation of stays in the list: missing (codes) or items[].missing, its row with the line «нет перевода — откроется главная» (the word missing, en and ru) under its name, its address home (a pattern with {code}) when given. (7) An app menu's «Язык» row: SfLanguage.menuEntry({languages, items, value, page, label, missing, home, href, searchFrom}) returns an sf-menu-context entry -- translate glyph, the current name as its value, a submenu of the same rows (the second name beside, C49) at the panel width (entry.width, sf-menu-context 1.17.0), a local search from search-from; the rows' ids are language:<code> and SfLanguage.codeOf(id) reads the code. (8) mode="field": sf-dropdown mode select as a form field, label above, the names as rows, search from search-from, sizes on the dropdown's ladder (1/3 -> 1/2, 3 -> 2); the element stays the form field. Relation cl-dropdown, lazy. (9) Variants: a code with a region or a script is named in full in its own words (Intl standard display, «Português (Brasil)», «中文（简体）»), its second name says what makes it one («португальский, Бразилия»; a script variant the shipped name «китайский, упрощенное письмо»); the code shown (trigger, labels="code") is the language alone while the list holds one variant of it (PT), language and region when it holds two (PT-BR, PT-PT), and Chinese by its script (简体, 繁體). A country choice is not sf-language; no flags. Same unreleased minor (core.styles, C142 first paint): before its code the element holds the box it will draw, from its attributes and the button ladder -- the «RU ▾» trigger (side padding, two glyphs, text space and a code slot one text line wide; 120 px at size 1, 102 compact, 100 on a phone) for auto, menu and search, the track height for inline, the label line, its gap and the field for field; one language holds nothing -- so a header no longer moves by the trigger (up to 118 px before); the code stands in that slot in the drawn trigger too.

version 1.4.3 (2026-11-14, a patch; owner decisions C142 (1) and C130, the first paint in a site header; written on the branch as 1.4.1): the trigger's code stands in a slot exactly one text line of its size wide (core.styles, hash only), the width core holds for the trigger before the code arrives, so the box held and the box drawn are equal and the tools beside it never move. It grew to the code before: two capitals wider than the line -- RU at the 12/16 step of size 1/3 and of size 1/2 compact and on a phone, size 3 on a phone, MN at every step, any code in the fallback face a cold load draws first -- widened the trigger and moved a header's tools by 0.7-6 px (sf-header-site with the printed snapshot: 0.8 at size 1, 1.7 compact and on a phone, 2.6 at size 1/2 compact). Such a code now stands out of its slot by the same amount on each side, into the text space beside it. A list with a longer code (PT-BR, 简体: more than two letters, or letters wider than a capital) keeps a slot sized to its widest code, as before. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.2 (2026-11-14, group build 5; numbered above 1.4.1 on origin/fix/language-first-paint): a patch, its own code unchanged: 5 first-paint snapshot file(s) follow the merged markup (first-paint retake).

version 1.4.4 (2026-11-15, DEV return TT-11 of the GB6+GB7 intent acceptance, owner decision C160 (1)): a patch: the menu trigger names itself by the Framework's tooltip («Язык: Русский» on hover, keyboard focus or a long press), not a browser title; the surface stands after the menu, named by the trigger's data-tooltip, and the tooltip component is a lazy relation asked for once a trigger draws. The accessible name (aria-label) is unchanged.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-16, queue #70, fields ladder): a minor, a look. The field look (look=field, C142 (8)) is sf-dropdown of the language's own size at every step: sf-dropdown stands on the whole field ladder since 1.18.0, so at 1/3 and 3 the field is 28 / 56 high at 1440 beside buttons of the size -- it drew sf-dropdown 1/2 and 2 (32 / 48). It writes appearance="bordered" on that dropdown, the field look's name since sf-dropdown 1.18.0 (FM-9; same look). Other looks, settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.5.2 (2026-11-17, feat/lang-file-c282; numbered above 1.5.1 on origin/fix/utilities-c264): a patch. Russian is a language file (owner decision C282, 2026-11-17): the bundle carries the English words only (lang/index.mjs, written by scripts/build-language-packs.mjs from src/core/lang/built-in.json); the Russian ones come from core/lang/ru.js included before core, or from the ru part of its family that core fetches, and SF.Loader holds the definition until that part is here (at most 800 ms). A page with the language file draws the same Russian as before; lang/ru.json is unchanged.

version 1.5.3 (written on the branch as 1.5.1; 2026-11-17, owner decision C268; numbered above 1.5.0 on origin/fix/fields-sizes-e2): a patch, nothing to see. The template writes pointer-events-none, the class named as the property, for pointer-event-none, its former name until 2027-01-01 (journal class-c268-pointer-events), so a page of the component no longer notes a deprecation. Settings, values, events, keys and drawing unchanged.

version 1.6.0 (2026-11-18): a minor (owner decision C278: languages of CIS countries other than Russian are not added and not named). The names table (data/names.json) no longer holds uk, be, uz, az, hy, ka, tt, ky, tg, ba and tk (54 languages ship, 65 before; tt and ba came back in 1.6.1), and the language file (core/js/lang/language-names) has no name-<code> word for them in any pack; removed with no dated alias (journal behaviour-cis-language-names-withdrawn). A product that lists such a code gets the browser's name for it (Intl.DisplayNames), as for any code the table does not hold. The examples and the twelve-language example say nl where they said uk. The menu entry (SfLanguage.menuEntry) reads its words through the registry aliases (core/lang/index.json aliases: a zh-CN, zh-SG or zh page takes the zh-hans words, a pt page the pt-br ones). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.6.1 (2026-11-18): a patch (dispatcher decision on C278: the decision removes languages of other CIS countries; Tatar and Bashkir are languages of regions of Russia). The names table holds tt and ba again (56 languages), with their name-<code> words in every pack and the Cyrillic font list; uk, be, uz, az, hy, ka, ky, tg and tk stay removed. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.7.0 (2026-11-19, owner decision C369, docs header study ui-control control/research/2026-11-19-docs-header, DEV msg-d9c2e1640ee24748b154 item 1.3; numbered above 1.6.1 on origin/fix/lang-follow and origin/integration/pair-next-15): a minor, all additions. trigger="icon": the menu's trigger is sf-button-icon with the translate glyph alone -- a square of the size's step, ghost on-surface, aria-haspopup menu, named «Язык: Русский» (the word trigger) -- which shows its name as the Framework's tooltip by itself (C160 (1)); the element draws no tooltip surface of its own then. The menu, the search, the sheet on a phone and the keys are the same. Core's first paint holds the square for it (core.styles, hash only: --sf-language--trigger is the box for sf-language[trigger="icon"], and an undefined sf-button-icon in the parts holds it too), so the tools beside it do not move. Relation cl-button-icon. The element's former undocumented getter trigger (the drawn button) is triggerButton now; trigger is the setting. Settings otherwise, values, events and keys unchanged. trigger name (owner decision C381 with C369, the Larena Panel sign-in screen 2026-11-19, DEV msg-cfe379b5d6aa492c8ba6 item 1 a): the glyph and the current language's own name in the link role -- a native button with component link's classes sf-link sf-link--navigation (component.link 1.4.0: the navigation form, a link that is a button, the line kept while its menu is open) -- as wide as the name, no tooltip, named as the other triggers; relation link added; core holds its box at one line of its place before the code (its width is the name's, which no attribute gives).

version 1.7.1 (2026-11-20, fix/reds-before-gb15; above every origin branch; numbered above 1.7.0 on origin/feat/header-compact): a patch, probe only. probe.json p5-menu reads the trigger's name on the German page in German («Sprache: Deutsch»), as the component says it since the C278 language packs; it expected the English name. forbidden_client_responsibilities: translating the page's own content (the site serves each language)
restoring a remembered language before the first paint (the site's inline script)
keeping the rest of the path when a site switches /ru/... to /en/... (cancel change and navigate)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-language once in a site header (sf-header-site's tools slot at size 1/2) to choose the site's language from a list of codes: a button «RU ▾» and a menu from two languages. On a settings page where every language should be in sight write mode="inline" (a segmented switch).
do_not: Do not draw flags or a globe for languages; the element uses the translate glyph and the names
Do not give a supported language a label of your own to fix its name; the component ships the names of its languages (data/names.json) and the browser names the rest
Do not use sf-language for a country or a region; it picks languages
Do not build a separate switch for two languages and a menu for many; one element is the same button and menu for every count, and mode="inline" is the switch of a settings page

keyboard: Inline (mode="inline"): Tab reaches the chosen language; the arrows, Home and End move the focus between languages and choose nothing; Enter or Space chooses (C142 (4))
Menu (auto from two languages): Tab reaches the trigger «RU ▾»; Enter or Space opens the menu; the arrows move, a letter jumps, Enter chooses; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger

Search: the field takes focus when the menu opens; Down moves to the rows. The menu opens with the chosen language in view; without a search the chosen row takes the focus. On a phone's sheet (from search-from languages) no field takes the focus: the chosen row does
accessibility.focus: After a choice in the menu, focus returns to the trigger; in the switch it stays on the chosen segment.
